# Russin Homes

> Russin Homes is an award-winning custom home builder based in Youngsville, North Carolina, serving Youngsville, Wake Forest, Raleigh, and the surrounding Triangle area. Builder Jeremy Russin has built new homes in the Triangle since 2004 and is directly involved in every Russin Homes build. NC General Contractors License #80218.

Russin Homes has Parade of Homes recognition across five separate years: Gold in 2020, Silver in 2022, Bronze in 2024, Silver and Best Kitchen in 2025, and Bronze in 2026 (Category 18, $960,000 to $1,100,000) for Sitting Pretty at 1123 Dovefield Lane.

Contact: Jeremy Russin, 919-520-7342, russinhomes@gmail.com
